name: What is the process for painting a bathroom with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for painting a bathroom with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our bathroom painting process begins with a consultation to understand your vision and assess the space. We then provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, our team prepares the area by cleaning, repairing surfaces, and protecting fixtures. We apply high-quality, moisture-resistant paints with precision, followed by a thorough cleanup and final inspection with you. This systematic approach ensures a smooth project flow and a superior finish, reflecting our commitment to quality in every East Bay home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, estimate, prep, painting with quality paints, cleanup, and a final inspection.
